Well, it's been about 15 years. 15 years? Before it was the tradition of catching shrimp everyday And now after many years we for this video we are remembering the traditions of this village fishing with the bait, fishing artisanal in the river, pick up little shrimp so do you think we can catch how many shrimp for our breakfast tomorrow? well, it depends if you can you would catch very much first that we catch very much to be able to breakfast well We catch quite a lot to have good breakfast here with ms Gabriel He will tell you how the traditional nasa fish is made here in the rural area for river artisan fishing, so during the video. I think it is fine, I say that we are going to disassemble one I hope you have enjoyed the river with the traditional fishing house. It was a tradition in these lands. I hope you like it. Don Gabriel, what is your message to those people who are going to look at us? Well, it looks small here because aling is taken out in this quantity. What customs would you like me to record? Comment and here we are pleasing all those people who ask us. So thank you very much for having accompanied us, I thank you from here, from the interior lands of Panama. Greetings and until next time.

The preparation and placement of the woven trap are consistent with a practical fishing and cultural-documentary context. The request to subscribe and activate notifications is ordinary audience engagement, not a condition for obtaining money, access, credentials, or participation in a financial scheme.
